character.name: Bastion
character.author: Noah
character.description: A towering frost-paladin in steel-and-ice plate. Slow to move, slower to fall, and every swing of his glacier maul lands like an avalanche.

character.name: Ember
character.author: Noah
character.description: A street-fighting prodigy whose wrapped fists burst into flame. Fast, aggressive and built for combos: fireballs, blazing kicks, a dashing rush and a rising phoenix uppercut.

character.name: Mirelle
character.author: Noah
character.description: A tide-witch who bends the sea to her coral staff. Floaty zoner: lob water orbs, spray pearls, ride a waterspout home and finish with an erupting geyser.

character.name: Volt
character.author: Claude
character.description: A pocket-sized hover-bot running on pure static. Tiny, floaty and fast, Volt zips in, shreds with multi-hit sparks, and blinks away before you can blink back.
